claim: Titles may need a timed key sequence: a key only after the tune starts, all keys up before the next wait, startup keys anchored to the entry PC; pokes applied after the start key miss the test level.

evidence.text: The title takes its key only once its tune has started; a key too early never reaches the menu.
Pokes on the game's menu were applied after the key that started the game, so the test level did not take.
The READY wait needs all keys up and then one down; a script must leave gaps between keys.
A loading screen changes input timing; anchor startup keys to the entry PC and assert real player updates before a long soak.
Key 1 starts the game and is held about 2 s until the tune reaches its key test.

next_check: After the start sequence require the probe count to rise and a game-state byte to change within N frames (as scripted-keys-must-reach-game).
